moire-drone.description: Sends built-in colored noise or live microphone and audio-interface input through interacting two-dimensional wave fields, a Shepard-wrapped Q/FFT lattice, and a visible damped mass-spring frequency fabric shaped by direct grabs and user-triggered propagation.
moire-drone.start: Turn on Audio, choose a preset and sculptor, then grab or pluck the fabric. To filter live sound, choose Mic / Audio In, select the device and channels, then Connect input. Presets, Next and Random preserve the source, input connection and output level; motion remains manual.
